objective: Construct a real compound-publication graph for study-effect identifiability without using activity outcomes for target or component selection.

candidate_targets.rationale: human serotonin 1A receptor; established pharmacology target
human dopamine D2 receptor; established pharmacology target
human cannabinoid CB1 receptor; natural-product-relevant receptor
human dopamine D4 receptor; established pharmacology target
human norepinephrine transporter; established pharmacology target
human serotonin 2A receptor; established pharmacology target
human serotonin 2C receptor; established pharmacology target
human adenosine A1 receptor; established pharmacology target
human mu opioid receptor; natural-product-relevant receptor
human delta opioid receptor; natural-product-relevant receptor

target_selection_rule.rank: lexicographic by repeated compounds, overlapping study pairs, multi-compound studies, then target ID

eligibility.context_selection: largest connected eligible context per target using identifiers only; ties by context key

natural_product_definition: exact standardized-InChIKey match to the existing NPASS-3.0 plus COCONUT-2024-08 index

partition.unit: connected component of the compound-publication bipartite graph within target and compatible context
partition.future_evaluation: components containing at least one publication from 2020 onward
partition.leakage_contract: compound and publication nodes may occur in only one partition; evaluation labels remain quarantined

identifiability_gate.interpretation: necessary structural gate only; it does not prove statistical identifiability

amendment_log.change: Corrected receptor name from serotonin 1B to adenosine A1 after authoritative ChEMBL target metadata retrieval.
amendment_log.effect_on_selection: none; target ID, inclusion, and identifier-only selection rules were unchanged
